results.name: Partial candidate accepts then resumes with two owned receipts and fixed versions
Integral candidate awaits explicit completion without resume or complete
Invalid or stale candidate cannot be accepted
Lost resolve response and similar GET do not authorize resume; explicit replay does
Lost resume response replays only that same resume and never repeats resolve
503 or timeout before resume retains accepted checkpoint and identical envelope
Archived project or completed task rejects resume but keeps accepted time
Another tab changes version after own resolve: never borrow its version to resume
Another tab cancels or replaces session after own resolve: no continuation
GET failure after own resolve does not start work on an unconfirmed snapshot
A rejected resolve cannot be inferred from matching state from another operation
Wrong receipt ID command ID version decision or result rejects acknowledgement and preserves retry
Repeated activation while busy creates only one resolution and one resume
Reload loses continuation and GET never automatically retries or resumes
Historical resume replay cannot regress current state or send another command
